The '''Council Chamber''' of the [[New Jedi Order]]'s [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]] was where the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]] convened. Surrounded by [[Starship/Legends|starships]], it was grounded on [[Taivas]]. During the [[Attack on the Hidden Temple]], it remained on the ground when the rest of the temple rose into the air. An [[Annihilator-class starfighter|''Annihilator''-class starfighter]] crashed into it, [[Death/Legends|killing]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]] [[T'ra Saa/Legends|T'ra Saa]] and [[Rawk]] and destroying the chamber. The two focused a [[beam of light]] at the moment of their deaths, which rose into [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and destroyed several enemy ships of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]], thereby creating an escape corridor for the overmatched [[Alliance (Second Imperial Civil War)|Alliance]].
